tables.name: cut_cutover_closure
checks: source identities are positive and immutable after insert
DRAFT requires final_result/submission/archive/result_ref fields null and permits incomplete result fields
SUBMITTED requires all three normal flags, rollback_occurred, final_result, positive submitted_by and submitted_at=archived_at
SUBMITTED SUCCESS requires result_ref exactly CUTOVER_CLOSURE:{id}:{submitted closure version}; SUBMITTED FAILED requires result_ref null
a false normal flag requires its non-blank detail
rollback_occurred=false requires rollback_successful/reason null; true requires rollback_successful and non-blank reason

tables.name: cut_cutover_closure_attachment

columns.file_hash: VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL

checks: purpose is one of the closed attachmentPurpose values
artifact/reference/version/scope/hash are copied from one PLT fact and never inferred from URL
POST_COLLECTION_CHECKLIST and IMPLEMENTATION_COMMITMENT each have exactly one current reference at submit

tables.name: cut_cutover_collection_evidence

columns.dispatch_marker: TINYINT GENERATED AS (CASE WHEN evidence_type_code IN ('DISPATCH_ACCEPTED','DISPATCH_FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) STORED
columns.callback_marker: TINYINT GENERATED AS (CASE WHEN evidence_type_code IN ('CALLBACK_SUCCEEDED','CALLBACK_FAILED') THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) STORED
columns.manual_marker: TINYINT GENERATED AS (CASE WHEN evidence_type_code='MANUAL_UPLOAD' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) STORED
columns.creator: VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL

checks: stage and evidence type use the closed enums
all external opaque identities preserve Owner case and compare with explicit case-sensitive semantics; no case folding is allowed
callback types require callback_event_id and immutable result identity; one collectionTaskId has at most one terminal callback

MANUAL_UPLOAD uses collection_task_id=original_failed_collection_task_id, requires original failed task plus manual_attachment_id referencing a MANUAL_COLLECTION_RESULT closure attachment, permits at most one manual result per failed task and never changes the failed row
dispatch types have no callback identity; recorded_by=0 only for trusted callbacks
dispatch, callback and manual rows may append only while their closure is DRAFT; SUBMITTED closure evidence is immutable

taskForwardChange.cut_task: add ARCHIVED to task_status and allow only P6/ARCHIVED for NEW_PLATFORM terminal tasks
taskForwardChange.cut_task_device_scope: submit explicitly clears active_marker for every row of the archived task; no implicit trigger

jsonContracts.device_scope_watermark: exact frozen task watermark, stable deviceId ascending; never refreshed from current Owner facts

beforeBusinessLocks: validate trusted tenant and structural request
PlatformCommandExecutionApi reserves/claims tenant+scope+Idempotency-Key; REPLAY_COMPLETED returns without CUT row access
newOperationBusinessLocks: cut_approval_instance and submitted cut_plan_revision source identities
closure attachments and collection evidence by stable identity
transactionOrder.successCompletion: inside the same caller-owned transaction persist business writes, mark platform idempotency COMPLETED, append operation audit and append required Outbox; any failure rolls back reservation and all writes

stateTransitions.createDraft: P6/CLOSURE_IN_PROGRESS with approved source -> DRAFT closure; task unchanged
stateTransitions.requestCollection: existing DRAFT version CAS; one device request appends one DISPATCH_ACCEPTED or DISPATCH_FAILED row and increments closure version
stateTransitions.collectionCallback: new callback may append only to a matching DISPATCH_ACCEPTED of a DRAFT closure and increments closure version; same callback replay is no-op; new callback after SUBMITTED returns CLOSURE_ARCHIVED with zero CUT writes
stateTransitions.linkManualResult: DRAFT version CAS; atomically append one MANUAL_COLLECTION_RESULT attachment and one MANUAL_UPLOAD evidence pointing to it; increment closure version
stateTransitions.submitSuccess: DRAFT->SUBMITTED and task P6/CLOSURE_IN_PROGRESS->P6/ARCHIVED; release device markers; append history and CutoverCompleted outbox
stateTransitions.submitFailure: DRAFT->SUBMITTED and task P6/CLOSURE_IN_PROGRESS->P6/ARCHIVED; release device markers; append history; no CutoverCompleted

eventOutbox.rule: SUCCESS submit only; unique per closure; resultRef is copied unchanged from cut_cutover_closure.result_ref; downstream failure cannot roll back CUT archive

migration.qualification: a source unit must independently prove one complete closure with all result unions, final result and valid immutable file facts
migration.lifecycle: CUT caller-owned outer transaction claims one STAGED_READY batch to RECONCILING, pages frozen sources, appends exactly one classification per source, and calls completeReconciliation with the claim-returned batch version and recomputed unique-source counts
migration.sourceIntake: a controlled Release migration importer alone calls PlatformMigrationEvidenceApi createImportBatch/appendSourceRecord/markStagedReady; CUT production beans never read the legacy table, files or a legacy datasource, and test fixtures are not production migration evidence
migration.currentDisposition: qualified target writes=0; structurally valid legacy step rows append ExternalMapping with resultType=RETAINED and empty targets; only corrupted frozen source identity/payload appends issueType=FCUT006_SOURCE_RECORD_INVALID
migration.counts: mappedCount=0 and sourceCount=retainedCount+issueCount; CUT target writes, PLT classifications and final count completion share the same transaction
migration.retry: temporary PLT/DataAccess failure rolls back the caller transaction so the batch remains STAGED_READY and writes no permanent issue; no staged batch means paused/no-op processing

controlledSubstituteBoundary: CUT src/test may simulate valid ProjectScope, PLT file and INT-12 dispatch/callback facts for the normal closure; no substitute may be registered in production or used as real-browser/Implementation Done evidence
